title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 18（2026-11-15）
summary: 最新成績仍是 Day 13 的 17/25（Day 14–17 還沒交卷）。今天繼續練弱點：if 子句和 will／would／could 配對（3 題）、keep／find／make + 受詞 + 形容詞（3 題，含 closed 與 surprisingly bright 對照）、whose／who 對照、Despite、must 後接原形、be responsible for、Part 7 的 instead of 舊地點陷阱和 NOT 題、Part 2 的同字異義陷阱（voice、train、park、file）。聽力今天是 Part 4 電話留言。做完按「交卷」就會自動回傳成績。

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 11 分鐘）
sections.tip: 假設語氣先看主要子句：will 配 if 現在式；would 配 if 過去式（be 用 were）。make／keep／find + 受詞 + 空格：描述受詞用形容詞；但空格後面若還有形容詞，空格就是副詞。Although 接句子，Despite 接名詞。

qs.stem: If the weather ------- good tomorrow, we will hold the picnic in the park.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 will hold ＝ 真實可能發生。2. if 子句用現在式，the weather 單數用 is（即使講的是明天，也不用 will be）。3. 選 A。B、D 只能配 would。

qs.stem: If the manager were here, she ------- the problem quickly.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. if 子句 were ＝ 與現在事實相反（經理不在）。2. 主要子句用 would + 原形。3. 選 C。A will solve 是 Day 13 Q4 的同類陷阱。

qs.stem: If we ------- more staff, we could finish the project earlier.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 could finish（could ＝ would 家族）＝ 與現在事實相反。2. if 子句用過去式 had。3. 選 B。A have 要配 will／can。

qs.stem: Please keep the door ------- during the inspection.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. keep + 受詞（the door）+ 空格，描述受詞狀態要用形容詞。2. 門是「被關上」的狀態，用過去分詞當形容詞 closed。3. 選 A。B closely 是副詞（密切地），是陷阱。

qs.stem: Many customers find our online service very -------.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. find + 受詞（our online service）+ very + 空格。2. very 後面接形容詞，描述服務「方便的」。3. 選 convenient。B 副詞是 Day 13 Q6 的同類陷阱。

qs.stem: The new lighting makes the lobby look ------- bright.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後面還有形容詞 bright。2. 修飾形容詞要用副詞 surprisingly（出乎意料地）。3. 選 C。對照上一題：空格後沒有形容詞時才填形容詞。

qs.stem: Ms. Park is the designer ------- ideas won the award.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後先出現名詞 ideas，再接動詞 won。2. 「那位設計師『的』點子」。3. 選 whose。

qs.stem: The technician ------- repaired the copier will come back on Friday.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後直接接動詞 repaired，缺主詞。2. 先行詞 technician 是人，用 who。3. 選 B。對照上一題：後面是名詞選 whose，是動詞選 who。

qs.stem: ------- the heavy rain, the outdoor concert was not canceled.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後 the heavy rain 是名詞片語，沒有動詞。2. 讓步語意又接名詞，用介系詞 Despite。3. 選 B。A、D 是連接詞，後面要接完整句子；C 語意不合。

qs.stem: Visitors must ------- at the front desk before entering the building.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 助動詞 must 後面接原形動詞。2. 選 sign in（登記）。

qs.stem: The marketing team is responsible ------- planning the product launch.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. be responsible for ＝ 負責，固定搭配。2. 選 B。易混淆：be in charge of 用 of。

qs.stem: The number of online orders has ------- sharply since the website was updated.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. has + 過去分詞 ＝ 現在完成式，搭配 since。2. 選 increased。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 9 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先讀題目、圈關鍵字（mainly、Where、must、NOT），再回原文找那一句。看到 A instead of B，A 是新的、B 是舊的。NOT 題四個選項都要回原文打勾。
passage: To: All Staff　From: Human Resources　Subject: Change to Health Check Date
The annual health check that was scheduled for Tuesday, December 1, has been moved to Thursday, December 3. It will take place in Conference Room B on the third floor instead of the cafeteria.
Please do not eat anything after 10 p.m. the night before, and remember to bring your employee ID card.
If you cannot attend on December 3, please contact Ms. Lin in Human Resources at extension 315 by November 27.

qs.stem: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
opts: To announce a new cafeteria menu
To report a change to an event
To ask staff to work overtime
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 目的題看主旨與第一句：Change to Health Check Date，has been moved。2. 選 B。

qs.stem: Where will the health check take place?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 找 take place：in Conference Room B … instead of the cafeteria。2. instead of 後面是「原本的」地點。3. 選 C。A 是舊地點陷阱。

qs.stem: What should employees bring?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 找 bring：remember to bring your employee ID card。2. 選 A。C 是陷阱：信中說前一晚 10 點後不要吃東西。

qs.stem: What is NOT mentioned in the e-mail?
opts: The new date of the health check
Who to contact about a problem
How long the health check will take
What time employees should stop eating
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：NOT 題逐一打勾。A：December 3，有。B：Ms. Lin, extension 315，有。C：沒提要花多久，選 C。D：after 10 p.m.，有。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 6 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先聽清楚第一個字（Haven't／Why don't／Who／or／When／Can you）。Wh 問句不用 Yes 回答；選項裡重複題目的字或發音相近的字（close／clothes、to／two）通常是陷阱。

qs.stem: Didn't you send the invoice to the client?
opts: Yes, I sent it this morning.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 把 not 拿掉：Did you send the invoice?。2. B「有，今天早上寄了」直接回答。3. A 用 invoice／voice 發音相近陷阱；C 重複 invoice。

qs.stem: Why don't we have lunch at the new Italian restaurant?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Why don't we…? ＝ 建議「我們何不……」，不是問原因。2. B「好啊，中午去」接受建議。3. A 是 Because 開頭陷阱；C 重複 new restaurant。

qs.stem: Who's going to train the new employees?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Who 問人。2. B「人資部的陳小姐」。3. A 用 train（火車）同字異義陷阱；C 是 Yes 陷阱，Wh 問句不用 Yes 回答。

qs.stem: Would you like coffee or tea?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 選擇疑問句先刪 Yes 開頭的 B。2. A「茶，謝謝」直接選一個。3. C 重複 coffee。

qs.stem: Where can I park my car?
opts: In the lot behind the building.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Where 問地點。2. C「大樓後面的停車場」。3. A 用 park（公園）同字異義陷阱；B 回答 How long。

qs.stem: Could you file these reports for me?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Could you…? 是請求。2. A「我馬上處理」。3. B 用 file（檔案）同字異義陷阱；C 重複 reports。

sections.heading: Part 4 電話留言（建議 4 分鐘）
sections.tip: 播放前先讀三題，圈出 purpose、Why、until Thursday。第一題聽開頭 calling about…；最後一題聽 I'll… 那一句，注意是誰要做這件事。
script: Speaker: Hello, this is Linda from Bella Cucina restaurant, calling for Mr. Wang about your reservation this Friday at seven o'clock. You booked a table for ten people, but unfortunately our large private room is being painted this week.

Speaker: We can give you two tables next to each other in the main dining room, or you can move your reservation to Saturday at the same time. Please call us back at 555-0147 by Thursday at noon. I'll hold your Friday tables for you until then. Thank you.

qs.stem: What is the purpose of the call?
opts: To discuss a change to a reservation
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 目的題聽開頭：calling … about your reservation，接著說包廂不能用。2. 選 B。

qs.stem: Why is the private room unavailable?
opts: It is booked by another group
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 聽 but 之後：our large private room is being painted this week。2. 選 A。

qs.stem: What will the speaker do until Thursday?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 下一步動作題，鎖定 I'll…：I'll hold your Friday tables for you until then。2. 選 C。A 是陷阱：要回電的是 Mr. Wang，不是說話者；B 只是給對方的選項之一。
